requirements.title: Identity mode wizard shows the active auth mode with no hidden bypass
Local account flows use server sessions with no stored credentials

Elevation requests display scope, expiry and a bound receipt
Identity or tenant change invalidates cached protected data
Identity forms and confirmations are accessible on desktop and mobile
Release-qualification identity test client supports a live sign-in probe
Admin UI surfaces identity operations for users, roles and navigation
